captions.text: Some tasks need many pages read. Cori splits them across workers.
Maya asks for 20 biotech companies, each with a person to contact.
Cori starts four workers. Each one searches and reads company sites in a tab of its own.
The chat shows what each worker sees, live, with its own Stop and Take over.
The count climbs as rows come in.
Their finds merge into one table, with no company twice.
Each value keeps the page it came from. Export CSV and Copy take it anywhere.
In a new chat she starts another search. Stop all stops every worker and closes their tabs.
Cori never invents a value. Each one names the page it came from.
